PLATE 55

(All figures natural size)

Figs. 1, 2. Synthetodus calvini Eastman. Dental plate. E 2017, p. 150.
1, inserted face; 2, oral face, showing a large worn boss.

Fig. 3. Acmoniodus clarkei, n. g., n. sp. Type. Large dental plate, in oral view; nat. size. It shows an elliptical anterior rritor, and a larger, subtriangular, posterior tritor. (Cf. text-fig. 53.) E 2575. p. 152.
